notes.title: Patch 1.7.1h - Perk system change. More fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!

Another week, another round of improvements for Rum & Gun. I've been watching your streams of the game and it's been super useful feedback. Also, I've been getting reports of 'unresponsive' controls - if anyone could give more feedback on that, that would be a lifesaver.

Here are the full patch notes:

[b]-One of the perk rolls is now guaranteed to be an upgrade to an already chosen perk (part of a branch)[/b]
-Pillage has been reworked to give a powder crate instead of 2 gold (8 second cooldown)
-Currently rolled perks are highlighted and can be selected even in the skill panel. Perk roll panel is now hidden while skill panel is visible
-Modified Fort Bourbon terrain to make sequence breaking less likely
-Added new option to show the reload bar at the cursor
-Gamepad now supports ship boost
-Fixed: weapon item comparisons no longer use the default slot id, but looks for the most similar equipped weapons
-Fixed: two guns of same ammo type caused various bugs (e.g. firespitter and repeater broke reloading)
-Fixed: wrong socket passives were displayed in rune tooltip
-Fixed: bleed immunity from Cure was not working
-Fixed: hanged pirates can no longer be stunned
-Fixed: inventory hint was still mentioning "buying" items
-Fixed: better automatic spell layout when equipping spells in various orders
-Changed default key binding of ship mode from 'H' to 'Z' 
-Fixed: "Show enemy lifebars" setting was not remembered
-Fixed: if second pistol has more spells than main pistol, its spell action buttons were hidden
-Fixed: akimbo main gun's sword action now falls back to primary attack
-Fixed: visible edge of the map on Fort Bourbon
-Auto-aim for gamepads is now disabled while inventory or skill window is open
-Fixed: last patch has disabled active reloads for gamepads
-Fixed: "magazine" rune bonus was renamed to "reload", consistent with weapon tooltips
-Fixed: "reload" socket bonus was not displayed as percentage
-Fixed: keyboard cannons did not work when gamepad was connected
-Fixed: Typo in journal notification
-Slight change to auto-sell algorithm
-Fixed: F12 now brings up console in editor gui, not just while playing in editor mode

That's all for today. As always, if something got broken by the update, don't hesitate to notify me.

Borington

notes.title: Full launch, full sail!
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!

It's been over 4 years, but Rum & Gun is finally out of Early Access! Huzzah!
TL,DR: Now is a great time to try it!

The first public demo back in late 2019 was a rudimentary top-down shooter running in a web browser, with most of its design ideas borrowed from DOOM. No inventory, limited ammo pickups with no reloading, no powder or spells or stamina, and a basic perk system. It was an entirely different genre, leading to a bit of an identity crisis for the game. Let's call it 'growing pains'.
But thanks to your feedback it has matured (or rather mutated) into a full ARPG-shooter hybrid, with a 12 hour campaign and a real endgame. For that I am truly grateful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/9a929cf073cdbcd1348520b13511fed40cbaa781.jpg[/img]

But the story doesn't end here. The game will keep getting updates over the coming months, and I'll be needing your feedback now just as much, if not more so . For that the best place is our [url=https://discord.gg/rpqXuZPwQE]Discord server[/url], or the Steam forums. The new patch is still fresh, so if you detect any issues, let me know ASAP.

Now let's plunder some booty, yarrr!!!
Borington


P.S:

- Full Voice acting

notes.title: Almost there! Pre-release test version available
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys! 

Although the full launch of the game will have to wait for another couple of weeks due to unforeseen circumstances, I've uploaded a pre-release beta version to Steam. [strike]You can access it at Properties -> Betas -> pre-release. [/strike]

- More vendors added

- More achievements
- Multiplayer testing
- Workshop support testing and finalization
- testing, testing, testing....

notes.title: Path 1.6.8 - Brick and Mortars
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!
We start the yearrrr with a new experimental mission. Build your defensive lines around the Cartel Haven while Caponero and his captain mates are discussing your fate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/813fd11568c4b0540eb3fbb9a6f90c89577e7fa0.jpg[/img]

In this map you can collect lumber (by building Lumber Camps or by finding pickups scattered around the map) to unlock and build walls, tents, and various towers. This might become an endgame activity in the future, if you guys enjoy it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ffe8a059d86b57fbf791d9445c43ff8f3b4b5a41.jpg[/img]

A new reagent type has also been added: 15 different types of gemstone shards. They can only be bought at the moment from the game's first vendor, Madame Sophie.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/36663f6cd094b0473320e96e967e3fcb5095c3fe.jpg[/img]

Other changes:
- Level cap is now 100
- New music track: Operation Taiko
- New perk: Steel Pong. Reflected bullets that hit you are reflected back with extra damage
- New perk: Ghost Whisperer. Otherworldly Servant ghosts orbit at half distance.
- Caponero boss replaced with mounted version (basically a 2-phase fight)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a729d3175defd64538ff83f3d9778d122431bfc2.jpg[/img]
- Expanded maximum stash capacity to 60. You now start with 12 stash slots (8 was a coding mistake actually)
- New look for the Blood Ghoul, also renamed to Blood Guzzler. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/993becc78d21f9064ed7e6cf50f1036cf519ea76.jpg[/img]
- Added damaging swarms of flies to swamp maps
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/6af8da3e0a055412c6d37cd15413669f83681c6e.jpg[/img]
- Jump points are now visible and are no longer automatic
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/83299f926e5e2e00b576ee12c2759ef677ac6f75.jpg[/img]
- Items that are too expensive now also have red frames
- Treasure Hunt maps get a random rotation
- Units no longer die while birth animation is active, but they die afterwards
- Husk renamed to Thirstful Husk
- Bloated Corpse renamed to Bloated Fiend
- Changed lighting in Halls of Booze to improve visibility
- Removed a kraken from the Crimson Trench
- Updated rocks2 texture
- Increased Shark Cannoneer attack damage from 28 to 30
- Hurl Lava pierce nerfed from 85% to 80%
- You can no longer use your stash while in combat
- Some ships now have different sinking speed
- Items are no longer stuck in hero-unwalkable tiles (they can get out, but not in)
- Added various triggers to the editor
- Fixed: Witch Doctor can no longer be rescued in Summit of the Guardian
- Fixed: alert at end of Misson's Lagoon had a 10s delay
- Fixed: Crimson Trench exit could be triggered while enemy ships were still alive
- Fixed: cannon crew can no longer spawn in obstacle
- Fixed: activation range of glowing circles no longer depends on pulsing scale

That's all for today. Tomorrow I'm on a flight, so I can't fix any game-breaking bugs that this patch might introduce... (knock on wood). 
Sidenote: I've heard some feedback that the controls of the game are bad. If anyone has ideas for improvements, I'm eager to read them.

Borington.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.7 - The Big Guns!
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!

First of all, let me wish everyone very happy new year! I wanted to finish 2023 with a bang, and the new level, Misson's lagoon does just that. Avoid the cannon volleys of a huge battleship, while fighting the French colonial forces. I wanted to release the next map too, but I got sick :C . For spoliers you can visit the Borington Discord dev diary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/0cd0d7bbc14cd2684fc1573c773191e884136286.jpg[/img]

Another short map has been added right after the Wicked Mermaid in act 2. This serves as the new ship tutorial level. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/02c1dff987736b8f03806b725cc7224a57b8828e.jpg[/img] 

Ship combat has been changed in multiple ways:
- Ships are now healed by collecting Flotsam. Use your fiddle to attract some. Music still heals the ship at the moment, but significantly less (might be zero in the future, not sure yet)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a96e6213d844086205f376e6b045b4e13efa1004.jpg[/img]

- Ships with sails can use a speed boost. Can be even more useful for fast steering.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/7c6e1ceee9afa0ea77927c5fb9c7b7552e8dab63.jpg[/img]

- Enemy ships try to keep a minimum distance from your ship
- Ships now play a water sound effect while moving

Other changes:
- Important Notice: All old save games will be set back to the start of the map to avoid errors caused by map changes. Almost every map was changed in some way by this patch.
- Detailed stats screen accessible from the inventory
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/3c215b40cbf8992107571bc0388f70f3f4ae3ad3.jpg[/img]
- New spell: Flicker. Melee attack that teleports you behind the enemy. 
- New spell: Bubble. Slow-moving homing projectile that can be charged up for more damage and scale.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/3bca4598aac6b21e3c590fd610886ca6239cbf7d.jpg[/img]
    - also, updated model for bubbles
- New spell: Magic bullet. Homing bullet with a flat damage bonus and reflection resistance
- New mini-boss on the Haunted Landing: the Shorelord
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/d6152c69e1b7b3f734507095a437a8c788ae1055.jpg[/img]
- Added ship battle to Hooghly Crossing
- Compatible spells are displayed on equipped items when hovering over a rune
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/f0de296f4db52bbeb64d1a22fae5e4054b5b32b9.jpg[/img]
- New enemy type: Assassin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/bd6b746e0e433839f078ec9a37c3aa1510da466b.jpg[/img]
- Cursed Sailors can use Flicker ability
- Improved tutorials for reloading and sprint/sprint charge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/8019e17c35bc2a6af95949d3687941007619d9dc.jpg[/img]
- New animation for running with 2-handed guns
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/e560510418386fa9b6d57fe6328d0f67c5e7ff2f.gif[/img]
- New animation for walking/running with a shield
- Added custom grenade weapon model (not a retextured bomb).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/29831572d87fe3b9956fb71a367963d08ae4b802.jpg[/img]
- Updated models for shields and rum pickups
- Improved shell texture for Hermit Crabs
- Adjusted rifle/blunderbuss hero animation (gun is not tilted)
- Added Elemental / Bloated Corpse birth sound
- Added step sounds for giants
- Improved look for Stand Your Ground area
- Updated cursor texture
- Structures are dynamically updated on the minimap. Allied structures are shown in color.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/cc1ed55d8d6661ee5b81cdadbe7a85866680f9ca.jpg[/img]
- Structures have 2x smaller life bars
- Bleed damage and time scaling is now using a square root formula, and it scales with max hp. This means that on later levels it's not certain death.
- Some spells now inherit windup from charged weapons (rifle, javelin)
- Anchor now has sprint damage bonus
- Javelin uncharged projectile speed increased
- Anchor attack cooldown after switching has been reduced
- Immolation now supports burst attacks
- Increased bleed time on Hooks
- Soulfire no longer gives bomb regen, instead bomb per kill (when held, also applies to secondary weapon)
- Faultline and Bullet Slowing spells buffed
- Increased mutlishot powder cost of Hurl Lava from 1 to 2
- Explosive Parasite now has 30% spellpower damage bonus
- Added birth animation for Bloated Corpse
- Ocean Guardian is now a giant mudskipper, renamed to Marsh Guardian
- Reworked Jungle Protector into a larger enemy with very delayed attacks
- You get a guaranteed Torch at the start of Uncharted Tunnels
- Added camera shake to snake boss birth
- Changed color of saturation bar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/6ba06c00f2112fe8b64f0b42f95e99dbc14eaf29.jpg[/img]
- Improved look for GUI bar floaters effect
- Xp display arm now rotates gradually
- Retouched rock doodad and rock terrain textures
- Improved Destructible Rocks UV mapping
- Kraken's tentacle animations are no longer in sync at birth
- Buff display for "Near, Far" perk effect
- Off-screen hero projectiles now disappear, to not aggro enemies that are far away
- Fractional reloads are now accumlating instead of chance-based
- Homing projectiles no longer count for hit streak
- Gun loot types can now drop even if their pickup was missed (from next mission onward)
- Bone Snake boss can now be killed at 3 segments, not 2
- Reduced Crazed Torso life from 40 to 30
- Reduced Husk life from 50 to 45
- Reduced Skeleton life from 80 to 70
- Updated some editor GUI buttons
- Additive shader no longer writes in alpha channel - more correct shoreline shading
- Added custom maggot shadow model. Eliminates bias artifact
- Added new trigger actions to control rain, music track, enemy ship speed
- Added new trigger conditions: perfect reload, ship cannon use
Bugfixes:
- Fixed (from last patch): unit armor was ignored. MAJOR BUG!
- Fixed: Item tooltips could not go below inventory panel, even with reduced GUI scale
- Fixed: birth sounds are no longer played on map start
- Fixed: various Fort Bourbon bugs and issues. (e.g. soft-locking).
- Fixed: captured ship was still in focus
- Fixed: Trident sprint charge can no longer be spammed with 'Run and Gun' perk
- Fixed: possible error if projectile had water death SFX but no land death SFX
- Fixed: setting unit tags under 0 caused editor freeze
- Fixed: editor minimap reticle scaling
- Fixed: missing female version speech line in Sober Shore map
- Fixed: Scorpant Martyr ragdoll anim is missing. Disabled it.
- Fixed: jungle texture mistake

That's all for today! The next content update is being made at full speed right now, but my vacation ends this Tuesday. I hope to release at least another large patch in January, finishing the Madagascar arc and starting the final couple of maps. 
Until then, smooth sailing! Have a wonderful 2024!

Borington

notes.content:

notes.title: Patch 1.6.5 - Madagascar
notes.content:
Ahoy mateys!
Patch 1.6.5 continues the story, adding a new map with 3 new creatures, and a secret boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/069c6f2f3528070005b784bfd466b25a0c8c9cdc.jpg[/img]

A new area and unique bossfight has also been added to the Casemate of Fangs
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a2f3ec25c84958044d5f5339e96cda390e5fae70.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/4642cd87df00d860c343d4d3cba570408354ac71.jpg[/img][/url]

Other changes:
-Damage bonuses now stack additively, not multiplicatively. So in case of +100% spell damage and +100% fire damage a fire spell will have +200% damage, not +400%

- Probably fixed Steam Overlay incompatibility. I will need your help to test it, so let me know the results on the forum.

-Added custom item icons for Treasure Maps and hidden boss hint pages
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/d067092070faa00c02b08f3f3c54ebaf27ede057.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/dde0c72818c7fd3864dda1a288911e60b976eccd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/984b2f76782065e359775a7c1b8481770355533d.jpg[/img]

-Added item suffixes for legendary weapons (names determined by supported spell)
-Added more item prefix names (64 in total)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a8b4812644ea29ee17540c8612b806f24119c4b3.jpg[/img]

- Major decoration changes on the Shattered Peak level
-Added a hidden boss hint page to the Crumbling Cellar 
-Tweaked the animation and display time of damage numbers
-Added sound effect when hero is moving in grass
-Added a third, Radial targeting mode for gamepads.
-Added scroll bar to Load Game menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/c06778b0ecb6a9b5dba4ceddcecb43cf071af90b.jpg[/img]

-Increased monster power scaling in Treasure Hunt
-Increased Treasure Hunt price
-Increased default camera distance setting
-Added new monster roster to some Treasure Hunt zones
-Leaping Terror attack pattern has been changed

- Renamed Siren Queen to Queen of the Abyss

- Otherwordly Servant damage now scales with gold bonus stat instead of monster level
- Some minor doodad texture changes

Fixed: spell power perks were giving total damage bonus, not spell damage
Fixed: Bomb Capacity perks gave +5 instead of +3
Fixed: buff VFX and damage numbers were visible on invisible units (Rogue, ghosts)
Fixed: hit streaks were also increased by allied attacks
Fixed: speech in Hooghly Crossing was not gender-specific

Fixed: walkable pathing in unreachable areas in the Court of Tides
Fixed: Updated camera bounds on Halls of Booze

That's all for today. The end of Act IV is very near, but there will probably be 2-3 more patches before the full release. Until then, smooth sailing!

Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.6.4 - Hidden Treasure!
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!

Version 1.6.4 is out, adding a quintessential pirate game mechanic: hidden treasure maps. The maps generate a treasure randomly on the level. Compare the minimap and the treasure map carefully, and use the new Shovel consumable to dig up the loot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/241241b58ab79a66bbb71910cd56e3ebd4edbaab.jpg[/img]

Additional features:
- New two-handed weapon: Anchor . It has a powerful charged attack with 30% Perfect shot damage bonus. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ddda455577fbfa5cc3bec1956212058dc566a166.jpg[/img]
It also has 2 unique spell variants: the Ground Slam instead of Slam, and Faultline instead of Drunken Surge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/4f3b70b239f12bf65cdc6d3eee51a7e6602c8b70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/b6f44f69554496af52047e4ef79c800b68c95213.jpg[/img]

- 3 spells and a perk have been added around the new Corpse Explosion game mechanic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/aa0413b616817c91b13f3cbe59e243e9c5536f2e.jpg[/img]

- New perk : Painful Greed . May have good synergies with violins and gold drop stat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a1040dfb038c82fce427dd0d52bcf18e1c2100eb.jpg[/img]

- New spell for bottles: Summon Rum Elemental . The elementals have a limited duration, but you can extend it with a fiddle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ab1ab0d547b063de0a009e5cc598547a9d823405.jpg[/img]

- Iridescent Sockets were not dropping due to a typo. Also, for better readability, Iridescent runes are now much brighter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/b0d8c19b6f1dd7417eca0122dd39a136c54460db.jpg[/img]

- New randomized tilesets have been added and some old ones have been revamped for Treasure Hunt mode. The total number is now 20.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/3392fc21792479dbe6840c01a2f65ae47e5393c9.jpg[/img]

New fire resistant variant for the Husk: Crispy Dead
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ac216805f49178ada06bdc71940717fc19daf28b.jpg[/img] 

- Interaction with the Mountain Giant updated.
- To avoid confusion with the Treasure Map X , the secret boss area has a new look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/9763eba3cc91537f26d68c9108bb38a7fa7ce922.jpg[/img]

- The visuals of the Harass spell have been revamped.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a5dc5d46d68f8540c35fe1b523f5565015297d38.jpg[/img]

- Changed lifesteal calculation: lifesteal is now added quickly over time from a secondary container
- Hook tweaked: gives +3 life per kill by default, doesn't always have knockback stat, can have pierce, slightly buffed damage
- Hive and Hook can now have Sleeping Dart spell
- Hive projeciles can now pierce the same enemy multiple times
- Legendary Weapon now only drops every 3 levels in Treasure Hunt mode, but Treasure maps can give them too.
- Ailment damage marker is now dark red, and slightly smaller
- Low Stamina and Powder and Rum warnings are now part of the lower GUI panel
- Legendary item icon background made brighter
- If a dragged rune has a spell for an item, the item slot is now tinted blue
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/15affbb617a82db8c1dfaeee30e702e78eb46d78.jpg[/img]

- Bombs thrown by 'Surprise' perk now also stun enemies, base damage reduced to 50
- Dodge Gas stamina threshold lowered to 60%
- Reload stun perk now only activates while under 80% ammo
- Lighting Rod damage now scales better with spell level
- Slightly increased Trident hit radius
- Reduced Siren Queen's base damage
- Tweaked monster scaling on later levels
- Added thunder FX to Summit of the Guardian
- Lucky Shot perk can now only roll after level 3. Also, the perk's icon has been changed
- Leeway now displays the perk's icon when it activates
- Ricochet bouncing now has a sound effect
- Changed Puncture sound effect
- Tiny extension to the Crumbling Cellars
- Made Magma Chambers a bit harder
- Extended eastern side of Mudskipper Grove . Mostly visual change
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/7aafba6a2d568efc7455c138d18e9b9f0f4b183b.jpg[/img]

Fixed: Javelin's knockback stat did not affect the weapon's projectiles
Fixed: gold drop count did not scale with monster level
Fixed: Puncture cost no powder for melee weapons
Fixed: Liver Lord perk description was wrong, perk only decreases hp by 50.
Fixed: Flare and Fireworks were supposed to have 50% self-damage
Fixed: Trident was displaying Bayonet icon as melee .
Fixed: Item level circle is now always at the corner of the tooltip.
Fixed: attack animations for Slam spell were not handled correctly for all cases
Fixed: Minimap now also paints black areas that are unwalkable only for the hero
Fixed: Wizard model has no "ragdoll" animation frame, led to disappearing model and WebGL error
Fixed: Breakthrough perk's unapply was instead affecting a different value
Fixed: typo in saturation perks' description
Fixed: extended Octopus corpse decay time
Fixed: Serpentine Beast's gold and xp worth was too low
- Slight update to the basic tree model.

That's all for today. It's not as much as it seems, I'm just writing more detailed changelogs as time goes on. The next major update, 1.6.5 should  continue the story. As always, bug reports and feedback are appreciated. Until then, smooth sailing!

Borington

notes.title: Path 1.6.3 - The Octogon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/dbf6b6135caaf10eff50ce157c24d29d62c65e06.jpg[/img]

We are inching ever closer to the game's full release. Version 1.6.3 adds 2 new maps: the Octogon (new bossfight), and the Crimson Trench (new ship battle level).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/f1b7d4fdb2b1b3389761df69da79d20677a23b9c.jpg[/img]
Here are the other changes:
Monsters get stronger at a faster rate above level 35, 45, 55, 65, 75
Added stun resistance stat to enemies - most giants and Corsair Strongmen have 50% chance and duration reduction. For bosses it's 66%
Added Hermit crab enemy type
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/d033223be4dc91aa3e6cbc937e20d295eed84edf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/f5b451a8105f3f040ac918fdd0f6c624db5057e6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a0adae2ef7a34e0c818ef19ff377f9289770d521.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/d97125374746fe491278ce1b7689ec723b00acd9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ca1c67417c7a54c4d13cc502295b8c8b37f48cf6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/140faa086ad93fa28f863e6dadde1513f9445167.jpg[/img]
Rogue/Infiltrator/Heavy Cavalier now has cape instead of backpack
Company Elite / Weapon Smuggler model tweaked
Imps and Demons now have thematic decorations on their backs
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/74f256196d3af81e235cf35ce1eca5886b57e964.jpg[/img]
Renamed Sandal item to Shoe
Otherwordly Servant projectiles no longer pierce by default, but a new Perk has been added to enable it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ba77e15b2c5dae3673adbcaf357d852283795979.jpg[/img]
King Crab's base life increased from 900 to 1000
Frenzy costs double powder amount on Tridents
Revamped Pit of Souls encounter after Kraul's death + added exit circle to the zone
Survivor's Hideout fiddle interaction is now started by a use event

Moderate visual changes to the Mudskipper Grove zone
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/25a4f97569a726fb2c3a2f37e3367131242006a0.jpg[/img]
Minor visual changes to a lot of maps
Lava is now rising slightly slower on the Shattered Peak

Added limit do damage number scale, and now it also scales with monster level
Integrated dodge mechanic into tutorial
Changed title of Ungodly Beast hint journal page

notes.title: Version 1.6 - Treasure Hunt
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys! 
Hope y'all had a great summer. Or winter, depending on the hemisphere.
Version 1.6 is starting Act IV with a new town zone (Smuggler's Route) and a huge new map: the Pirate Citadel. I hope you'll like the scenery. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/7c612ba2f01f9c688f41959cf125b2c2c27efb7b.jpg[/img]

An even bigger update is the new Treasure Hunt mode accessible in the new town. It is an infinite series of random dungeons, that get progressively harder with each stage. Also, if you die, you can start it again from the first stage. Think of it as a roguelike mode. No cool boss fights yet, unfortunately, but since this is the first iteration of the feature, it can still change in various ways, depending on your feedback. It should also work in multiplayer, though I haven't had the time to test it thoroughly.
Currently there are 5 tilesets, each with a couple environment variations. Examples of random maps:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/2a146007c4cc46de9e6d2e85d364d9c9c28b9cd1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/cb37059aece901c9406cc494900a9edd0bee968d.jpg[/img]

- Another major feature is the introduction of rare items and epic weapons. They have color-coded icons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/655b78f35381791ccc54f4c2f6793e302f6de96d.jpg[/img]
- You can even upgrade common items to rares with a new reagent:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/c5aaaca401fe3c6e2a0d58a5d0232a2b332f7f60.jpg[/img]

- Weapons can now give bonus levels to a spell. This is added to the rune's spell level. This means that a spell level can go above 5. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/31ecb9df30c12910792783b35bbe9d85140b566e.jpg[/img]
These weapons only drop from "Legendary" weapon crates. These crates are found in Treasure Hunt mode, or dropped by bosses at the end of an act (Kraul, Prince, Avatar)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/d8deabbc17825d08fc8caa300fe5fc3442c01ef0.jpg[/img]

- The Hat Block is a new Reagent exclusive to the Treasure Hunt mode. It's basically transmog for hats. Please note that the implementation of this feature mixed up your current hat fashions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/3cd84d495006df49fcac0271ba0b1f9c01c55a23.jpg[/img]

- New enemy types: Siren, Pirate Siegebreaker, Corsair Strongman, Corsair Grenadier
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/5e87516342549ff00a7606abed126f5b6d5e3c82.jpg[/img]

- Loaded Dice, Gambling Dice and Sobering Syrup are no longer dropping from Reagent pickups. They have their own pickup type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/b0a97a795ae216e064de031aedf1706031090486.png[/img]

- The Pit of Souls zone has been extended (map has been doubled in size)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/14a20726fff122514da27093e19d5caf45a040c0.png[/img]

- The Inn zone has been extended, a new npc text has been added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/da5a4881a770859fd37c52d0460b60ac0f00bd54.jpg[/img]

- New ship type, the Galleon. Will have more uses in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ef4765fc6b461986bae178a4e0b728c1c3ce6947.jpg[/img]

- Npc speech can now be gender-specific
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/b4a94eb7befe3037e20915baeb43b6322288cfd6.png[/img]

- Aunt Rebecca now has a hat and her own unit type
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/fba19c044b33e9cbc26ec85b0548ef3797047abc.jpg[/img]

- Added stamina regeneration item stat to Shirts, leg armor and bottles
- Implemented inherent stat bonuses for body armor, boots and peg legs. This means some stat bonuses are no longer random, but guaranteed by item level
- Small adjustment to Barge ship model
- Shark Cannoneer attack damage has been buffed
- "Magazine" weapon stat renamed was to "Reload" to avoid confusion with ammo capacity
- Egg minion names are now included in the item name instead of the description
- Quantity of a consumable no longer has its own line in the item description
- Fixed: Speed penalty while drinking was totally broken, Gourd was useless
- Fixed: reagent use could not be cancelled. Now right click cancels it
- Fixed: Bullet Slowing alias text was not removed from Instant Reload tooltip
- Fixed: the last update broke hero water footprints
- Fixed: Sellsword was dropping too much loot
- Fixed: lava boulders had a chance to stop
- Fixed: client could not use teleport circles in multiplayer
- Fixed: multiplayer was overwriting the client's character on level change
- Fixed: joining a server that was previously abandoned by clients broke unit data sharing
- Fixed: client gender is no longer changed to male in multiplayer
- Fixed: More key names are displayed properly in Key Bindings menu
- Fixed: some attachment actors would disappear when parent was removed
- Editor: Rock HSL icon now displays rock terrain texture
- Editor: Added new palm tree variant, some new doodads

That is all for today. As always, major changes can lead to major bugs, so feel free to leave feedback on the forum or on the Discord server. It can be a life saver!
Also, [url=https://www.realmsdeep.game/]Realms Deep 2022[/url] is coming up on the 15th, and my upcoming game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2002610/Delilah/]Delilah[/url] will have a presentation. Make sure to tune in!

Until then, I wish you smooth sailing!
Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0 - Level Up!
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!

Version 1.5 is finally out, with a complete revamp of the progression system. Also, Act III has been continued with an epic boss fight.
Most important changes:
- You can level up your hero and gain semi-random perk points. Perk range from simple stat increases (extra life, powder, etc.) to brand new game mechanics ("Bayonet", "Stand Your Ground", "Perfectionist", etc.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/9dba2daed19e5674b07b6ca34b860eea19cf14c0.jpg[/img]

- Any of the 5 weapon categories can use any of the 5 weapon slots. Yep, you can equip 5 pistols if you want to.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/4dc487303a502634f6d55d971a447421597b796f.jpg[/img]

- New consumable items: collect Rune Dust to level up your existing runes, and also various trinkets to help you customize your perks (perk undos, access to the perk table, etc.) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/ac7c7fedb8e8c94e0096dc60cad9f4a3bbc62fee.jpg[/img]

- Rebalanced monster stat scaling - Because heroes are stronger when levelled up. Now enemies might become too strong on the map you were currently on, until you level up your hero a bit...

- You can now become a merman/mermaid!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/cfa2661ea8650f0642822778d5195930f1b96db4.jpg[/img]

- New weapons: Staff, Glaive
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/1b45e600c22c2cb467620e3fdb93c8685f185022.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/e6d5098191753f8e049420d5020879bff904caef.jpg[/img]

- New shield type: Plank. Shields now give more blocking in the front
- New bottle type: Liquor Bottle
- New hat type: Mask - Shaman and Bone fashioned helmets have been expanded and grouped into a new item type, aimed at spell casters. One of the new fashions is an Eyepatch! Yarrr!
- New spells: Ricochet, Puncture, Focused Shot, Spirit Servant, Fireworks, Toxin Bomb, Weapon Throw, Boomerang, Lava Hurl, Firebats II, Multishot II, and probably something I forgot about...
- Bombs can now have Bullet Nova spell

- More and better sounds: - New, crunchier sounds for all melee hits, new death and/or hit sounds for spiders, scorpants, wasps, skeletons, humans, snakes; updated Handgun shot sound, Perfect shot/reload sound, low stamina warning; new wind ambience; fireball hit sound and VFX
- New enemy types
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a4233382737e5a12dcaae43de4f3ffeb35be229b.jpg[/img]
- A lot of enemies have new mechanics: - Deserters are now Rogues that disappear in a puff of smoke, Crazed Abominations have a circle of flies around them, Bloated Corpses release a cloud of gas on death
- Enemies can be armored, absorbing a flat amount of damage.
- Violins now heal on every tick, and the effect lingers for as long as the instrument was played
- New stat: First sip : after 15 seconds, your rum bottles can give additional instant healing
- Burning attacks now cause burning ailment instead of bleeding - new visual effect, damage affected by fire resistance/weakness

- Expanded and updated maps: - Maps such as the Bush Fields and Quagmire of the Fallen have been expanded; most maps have received visual upgrades
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/9421feb50c735a916fdcc8cc7ecb7269a19bfbc6.jpg[/img]

- Optional bosses: - It's up to you to find and defeat them.
- Spell icons - displayed both on tooltips and on the main UI
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/e1fd21f8048a1a06dc2e44a469e5f2dd446c2c7b.jpg[/img]

- New doodads, tree textures, and other decorations.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/6ce944e318dbb953954991b4594346df1b06de1d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/57db06b37185792e9db13053861bd371ce527f2e.jpg[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/1849271f573058d15badc5971c87c23cbd7d171c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/bbcc7b8935d1cbc8befaa1b30299535d6ef8ba30.jpg[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/fdae187706e18ea6e9f7315d528ca779a6a4a2b2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/5a5fe1a56b6050bc16a626c4de61d7fe02711e4a.jpg[/img][/url]

- Spike traps as a new environmental hazard
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/cd6833e43753fd5426e8103ad8913ff2409c6619.jpg[/img]

- Hungry Maggots now shoot projectiles
- Lava is now mostly walkable, but it hurts like heck!
- The shader for burned enemies has been improved
- New death animation variant for lizards
- Rune item icons have been improved
- Minor change to grass terrain texture
- Updated Boat model, red ship texture
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/6592bd25498371c711132bbae861be1f69e76ebf.jpg[/img]

- MUCH better controller auto-aim
- New GUI scaling, updated game UI, expanded stash
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/bc23a0d7912139b93ce55d385d77ba3b347334c0.jpg[/img]

- Nova spell now plays spin animation
- Option for in-game Camera Distance. Also, default camera distance has been increased
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/336b5160585133b1885acecaf6b9f0ba3545fbe5.jpg[/img]

- Blocking now only absorbs 85% of damage, but Bleed and Rum Steal can be blocked
- Rampage - you get extra gold if you kill a lot of enemies in a short time
- Cannon projectiles are now slower
- Added hats to Sea Hunters
- Fiddle saturation healing is now linked to a perk
- Blunderbuss powder cost reduced to 4
- Charged shot's powder cost now scales with the charge. The spell has been renamed to Windup
- Shark Brute and Buto Ijo knockback factor decreased to 0.15
- "Inventory is full" message countdown now pauses in combat
- Fixed: rune passive bonuses were applied multiple times
- Fixed: socket level limit was using < instead of <= for comparison
- Fixed: unit owner change now preserves the unit actor scale
- Fixed: Gold factor stat was not displayed if it was a rune bonus
- Fixed: Ammo Pouch gave +15 bombs and 1 Repeater. It's been reversed
- Fixed: combo bar needed more precision on shorter bars
- Fixed: some Perfect Shot bonuses were broken
- Fixed: Ocean Guardian's loot was broken
- Fixed: Smoke bombs no longer affect allies
- Fixed: mouse inputs were not detected over the key bindings panel

Unfortunately, this update has probably completely broken the multiplayer. But I will try to integrate all the changes into the networking for the next update!
This update has been the largest since Rum & Gun came to Steam. A lot of updates are up to change in the future, and you may encounter new bugs, or broken game saves. 
Don't forget to leave feedback on the forum, or on the Borington Discord server

Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.4.12 - Spell Control Overhaul
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!
I've found a pretty large bug in 1.4.11, so I've decided to release the new patch early.
Here are the changes:
- Music files have been replaced with higher bitrate versions
- Complete overhaul of spell controls: now you can freely choose an action for each of the four attack/spell buttons. Each weapon has its separate spell layout. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/9ae75d4953a183748e1e0357ff64ec06bb20072e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.4.8 - Can't touch this!
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!
Tomorrow I'm going for a vacation, so I really wanted to put out once last update before that. After reading your feedback on the movement system, I decided to add a new stamina and dodge system. You can press the sprint button for a short moment to dodge in the direction of movement. You are invulnerable while dodging.
A new stamina bar has also been added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/704202ead4c7ebfd64a72a3fe947ada4fda2ce95.jpg[/img]

This also means that running now costs stamina instead of reserving life

Two new maps have also been added:
- The Boulder Cave: A short map after the Uncharted Tunnels, intended to teach the player how to sprint
- The Magma Chambers
Other changes:
- Added UI button to toggle ship control mode (same as H key)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/f28207a63ada90bbe9e4ea5f8fe74dd674edf2ec.jpg[/img]
- Added respawning items to some boss fights
- Certain items can now give maximum stamina
- Rum and Tonic now also gives stamina
- Sprint melee attack now spawns larger and orange sparks
- Higher level units now have slightly less health
- Elemental damage limit is now 10 instead of 5
- Talisman of Luck now gives +25% max health instead of 50 hit points
- Reloading when standing and moving now has the same speed
- Perfect reload combos now always give the same reload boost
- Made perfect reloads slightly easier
- Melee attacks of giants and some animals can be avoided - attacks have a 120 degree cone effect
- Gourd speed penalty is now zero
- Changed rarity of certain runes
- Made the Forbidden Cliffs map easier
- Changed enemy placement on the Sober Shore
- Added birth sound to Ice Rascal
- Added custom death sound to Ice Rascal
- Default and recommended button for dodge/sprint is now Spacebar
- Fixed: tooltip weapon icons could be visible on map start even when tooltips were hidden
- Fixed: Ice Rascals can no longer have charred corpses
- Fixed: after a charged shot, the charge bar would look like the weapon's reload bar for a split second
- Fixed: reload bar fade in/out is now framerate-independent
- Fixed: beacon animation is now framerate-independent
- Fixed: trigger bug on the Forbidden Cliffs map

That's all for now. As always, feedback is appreciated. I'll take a look at it as soon as I'm back from No Man's Land. Until then, keep sailing!

Borington

notes.title: Path 1.4.5 - The Loot Update 2.0
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!

Path 1.4.5 is live, adding so many changes, It's getting hard to list them. I had to cut the development short, because I found a game breaking bug on the Batavia Cellars map. But hey, there's always 1.4.6. . That patch will have at least 2 new maps (including the first arena zone).

Loot:
- Body armors, hats, boots and livers can now be socketed, each rune type gives a separate stat upgrade to each item type. This also means that runes are no longer Level 0, and have to be purchased
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/7870817ec1e1c06772082d9e7ce26eaa4fb0b760.jpg[/img]
- Strange Egg is now a separate item slot, and it can contain a variety of unique minions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/b443a10bbc79fae3b69f3c5dbcf55adc2c546ff5.jpg[/img]
- New melee weapon: Torch, deals fire damage
- New Bottle types: Gourd and Flask
- Two new rune types: Drunken Carving and Sober Carving
- Two new music instruments: Bugle and Skull Harp
- New socket item: Iridescent socket - applies both sockets on an item
- Iridescent runes: about 10% of runes are iridescent, they can fit into any colored socket
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/0030772d42067785e3e9cfad982d23835e44c653.jpg[/img]
- Items now cost significantly less. This buffs the value of dropped gold by about 300% 
       - Gold amounts from before patch 1.4.5 have been divided by 3
- Instruments can now give area knockback (Repulsive Note spell has been removed)
- New item stat: Rum Shield - some of the incoming damage is inflicted on your rum instead of life
- New item stat: Thorns - reflects some damage to the attacker
- New item stat: fire & bleed resist
- New item stat: First Blood - weapon deals higher damage if target has full health
- New item stat: Executioner - weapon deals higher damage if target's health is below 33%
- New item stat: Repeater ammo regeneration
- New item stat: Rum per kill
- New item stat: Life steal effect - increases the health got from your life steals, but doesn't give base life steal
- Some rune - spell pairings have been changed
- Countless small item stat tier changes
- Modified drop rates for a lot of items

Combat/Gameplay:
- Scaling of monster life and damage has been tweaked. With the addition of so many new progression options, late-game enemies had to be made stronger
- New spells: Smoke Bomb II & III - same as Smoke Bomb, stun lasts longer
- New spell: Oil Barrel - enemies in an area get a temporary decrease to fire resistance
- New spell: Morale - used with instruments - applies a temporary  healing buff to whole party
- New spell: Instant Reload - reloads a magazine in exchange for gunpowder
- New spell: Recycle Bullets - consumes a magazine of ammo in exchange for gunpowder
- New spell: Sleeping Dart - an alias of Concussive Spike, used with a Javelin. It's a 10 second stun on a single target, but in 1.4.5 stun duration is decreased if a creature is damaged.
- Nerfed shield damage reduction to 30%
- Smoke bombs can now be used with Soulfire and Hand Cannon
- Volley I & II can now be used with Javelin and Revolver
- Damnation can now be used with Flamespitter and Torch. Also, it's no longer an alias of Firebats
- Fiddle rum consumption now scales with monster level
- Bleeding from enemies now scales with monster level
- Enemies now always throw earrings instead of gold coin
- Whirl spells are more expensive
- Slam stun duration increased
- Company Grenadiers, Kraul and the Prince now deal fire damage
- Fixed: stun durations were inconsistent 
- Fixed: life per kill stat can now give life up to saturation limit
- Fixed: enemies in the prison arena could not be hurt 
- Reduced Liar's Dice bet size to 50 gold

Graphics and sound:
- Separate ambient sounds for cave and city levels
- Improved graphics and sound for unit alerts, improved shooting sound for Handguns and Twinguns
- Fiddle sound is now softer
- Minor decoration changes to most maps. New doodads include new fruit pile variants, fishing nets, flags
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/9187c5b6764472e8271f63d97b8551ef2dc27825.jpg[/img]
- Tents have improved textures
- Company grenadiers now wear a metal helmet
- Fixed: camera speed, ragdolls and height fog motion are no longer frame ate-dependent
- Fixed: ropes no longer flicker because of math precision issues

UI:
- Fixed: item tooltips should now always display the correct item
- Touched up some item icons
- Item tooltips can no longer go under the bottom of the screen
- Added fade in/out effect to tooltips
- Item tooltips widths are dynamically resized
- Lifebars made longer and narrower, and get a slight color change if unit has low health

I think those are all the notable changes. As always, feedback is much appreciated!
Borington

notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!
Patch 1.4.4 is out, adding so many things it's hard for me to list them. Still no new finished map, I'm planning on releasing all 3 WIP maps for the next update. - Changed Maggot model and Maggot Hatchling color

- Repositioned gold count text display to under the gold coin icon
- Locked items have new color

Gameplay:
- Melee weapons can now have spells and sockets. They're best used with a shield, but if the one handed gun you're holding doesn't have a given rune color, you can still use the melee spell of the same color
- 3 new body armors: Scale Mail, Vest, Coat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/26fe3fa3c298a3ed01efd8e59d4fd5ca08a23d00.jpg[/img]
- New bomb type - Grenade. Spawns 8 shrapnel on explosion. Shrapnel Bomb spell has been removed.
- Fiddles and Accordions no longer generate with spells. Instead they have sockets. 
- New spells - Melee: Flurry I/II/III, Whirl I/II/III, Harass, Slam; Fiddle - Earbleed I/II/III
- New Pegleg boot type
- Added Sober Etching and Drunken Etching runes
- New Socket item type: it can add a socket to an item.

- Added Hemorrhage effect to some monster attacks - hero will start bleeding for a couple of seconds

- Added Ocean Guardian monster type
- New gold sell cost calculation. Later-game items are sold for less than before
- Various item stat and stat roll probability changes
- Increased Salamander Lord life, decreased damage

Most maps have received minor visual tweaks after the terrain texture update. Layout and monster placement changes happened on:
- The Forsaken Valley - added another human camp
- The Mudskipper Grove - added a new side area with a mini-boss elemental and high quality loot
- Minor layout changes also occurred on The Bush Fields and the Uncharted Caves

Bug fixes:
- A lot of them. Sorry, this changelog is already long enough.

All in all, I hope the next update will be at least this significant.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3 - The Map

Ahoy, mateys!

The March update (technically April update for non-Americans) is out! No new level this time, but some really cool ones are in the works. Expect them in 2-3 weeks. However, this one's still one of the longest changelogs I've written.

notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys!
The first February update is out, continuing the adventure. Don't forget to restart your level is you were on the last map of the previous version!
Here's what's new or changed:
- Two new maps: the Serpent Plateau and the Casemate of Fangs
- Image Post-processing: Bloom, chromatic aberration and a tiny amount of color correction

- Sober and Drunken spells can be used at the same time (by default one is SPACE, other is SHIFT, switch priority with TAB)
- Improved GUI (hopefully): New ammo cards, new life/powder container, improved powder graphics
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/a64635ea949a39b4146702086d4850006a30b0ed.jpg[/img]

- Added lily pads to the swamp areas
- Added fire doodads to various places
- Added speed limit to reflected bullets, so they're easier to dodge
- Changed rune-spell pairings: Propulsion is now Sober spell, Multishot is Drunken spell

Safe sailing!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.3 notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.3 added the following changes:
- Gold is now dropped when an enemy is hit, not only on death.
- Added Golden Earrings. They give +1 gold, but they disappear in a few seconds. Their function is to encourage staying close to the combat area instead of kiting endlessly.
- Difficulty can be changed in the Options menu at any time.
- Hard difficulty now has better loot.

notes.title: Tuesday Changes and thoughts - 1.2.2
notes.content:
- Patch 1.2.1e fixed some issues with the reload GUI. The appearance/disappearance is now gradual, and the markers are only green on 'perfect' timing. Some minor rune bugs were also fixed
- 1.2.2 added some much needed variation to the Uncharted Tunnels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36381089/6ced3ea9ce1f89d96918e1a98b13bca9f63bd958.jpg[/img]

I'm thinking about what to do about the story. Collectible pages sound nice to me, maybe some puzzles leading to hidden treasure? I might also change the first map as soon as ships are finished. 
In the meantime, I'm working on the brand new Multiplayer system. I don't want to make promises I can't keep, but I believe it can be done and tested in 2 weeks.

Until then, happy pirateering.
Borington
